row.evidence: Netlify's pricing page lists "SSO & SCIM" under Enterprise (Custom), and the Directory Sync docs say the feature is available on Enterprise plans and requires Organization SSO.
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Price change since June: Pro is no longer $20 per member; the pricing page now says '$20 /month with unlimited members' and the FAQ says credit-based Pro plans stopped charging for seats on April 14th, so team_price_per_user_mo is now null (flat, credit-tiered from 3,000 to 20,000 credits/month). Pricing page shows monthly prices only. Team and Organization SAML SSO and SCIM Directory Sync are Enterprise only; Directory Sync is set up through a guided per-IdP flow (no public SCIM base URL or token docs) and maps IdP groups to teams and roles (Owner, Developer, Billing Admin, Reviewer). Legacy (non-credit) plans still exist for older accounts and were not researched. The REST API members endpoints and team audit-log endpoint are public; adding members needs Pro or above.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Single user; cannot add team member seats.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: $20 /month with unlimited members (3,000-credit tier; higher credit tiers cost more)

operations.notes: Provisioning is group-driven: directory groups are mapped to Netlify teams, roles and site access; role changes are made per group.

deprovision.notes: Docs say users 'may change or lose access based on the relevant directory group mappings'; the per-user effect of removal in the IdP is not described. Deleting Directory Sync with 'Remove provisioned users' removes them from their teams.

roles.how: Directory group mapped to one Netlify role per team (Team Owner, Developer, Billing Admin, Reviewer), plus site access for Developers/Reviewers; highest role wins when a user is in several groups.

limitations.text: Requires Organization SSO (Enterprise; organizations are set up by the account representative).
Git Contributors can't be provisioned through Directory Sync.
Setting Directory Sync to Inactive leaves existing members with their teams and roles.

scim.notes: No public SCIM endpoint, version, token or attribute documentation; setup is a guided flow inside the Netlify UI per identity provider.

capabilities.notes: addMemberToAccount takes email and role (Owner, Developer, Billing Admin, Reviewer); updateAccountMember sets role and site access; removeAccountMember removes from the team.

endpoints.purpose: Add a member by email and role (addMemberToAccount)

audit_log_api.plan: Pro (team audit log is Pro and Enterprise)

rate_limits.text: Up to 500 requests per minute for most requests.

limitations.text: Free and Personal plans cannot add team member seats, so member management only matters from Pro up.

user_api.notes: Base URL from the spec's host api.netlify.com and basePath /api/v1.

okta.notes: No Netlify app in the OIN search; Netlify's Team SSO guide has admins create a custom SAML app integration in Okta.

entra.notes: No Entra gallery tutorial found (saas-apps/netlify-tutorial 404). Org SSO lists Azure AD SAML as supported (c21).

google.notes: Org SSO lists Google as supported (c21); no Workspace catalogue app checked.

open_questions: SCIM base URL, token, version, endpoints and attributes are not publicly documented (guided setup).
What happens to a single user removed from the IdP group (removed from team vs. deactivated) is not stated.
Which IdPs Directory Sync supports is not listed separately from Org SSO's IdP list.
Whether SAML sign-in creates Netlify accounts just-in-time is not documented (docs say users must be invited first).
Legacy-plan (pre-credit) pricing for SSO/SCIM not researched.
